notes: v0.3.30 - OpenAI keys work again. Every message was failing on newer OpenAI models: the model applies a reasoning setting of its own, which the API then refuses alongside the agent's tools. The app now retries the way OpenAI's own error asks it to. Also: adding SocialAgent to your Start Menu left two icons that looked identical and behaved differently - the one Windows created skipped the startup steps, so Docker and the browser helper never loaded. Both icons now do the same thing, and existing duplicates are repaired on the next start.
